# From Azure Boards to tasks

After a Cursor plugin install, the short command loop is [plugins/crav1/README.md](../plugins/crav1/README.md).

Use this when the tasks of a spec are already in Azure Boards, sent by [From tasks to Azure Boards](from-ado-sync-push-tasks.md), and the user wants what changed there back in the spec and `tasks.md`.

When the user asks for startup options, that ask names only `$crav1-spark-to-spec`, `$crav1-ideas-to-spec`, `$crav1-bundle-to-specs`, `$crav1-existing-to-specs`, `$crav1-read-environment`, and `$crav1-fix-bug`.

## First prompt

```text
$crav1-ado-sync
```

Or name a spec, for example `$crav1-ado-sync orders-retry`, or `all`.

## Steps

### Check first

The org and the project come from `docs/environments/marks.md`, or from the Azure DevOps URLs in `docs/system/repos.md`, the same way as `$crav1-ado-sync`. If `az` fails, the command states the issue, suggests a fix such as `az login`, and offers a skip. It does not install `az` and it does not log in.

### Pick a spec

The list shows the specs whose `work-item.md` has task lines, plus **All**. A spec without task lines points at `$crav1-ado-sync`.

### Read back and compare

It shows only what differs from the spec and `tasks.md`, with who changed it and when when the history shows that.

```text
T1 (#1234): Enable retries on dev
- State: Done (the task owner, date). tasks.md box is not ticked.
- Comment (a reviewer, date): "Can we also run it on test before Friday?"
```

Each id is read in its own home, the `(ADO: <org>/<project>)` tag on its line.

### Keep or dismiss

A kept change goes into the spec and `tasks.md` through `$crav1-add-to-spec`, quoted as `From ADO <date>. <who>.`

- A task that is in the done state in Azure Boards (the `Azure Boards task done state` line in `docs/environments/marks.md`) ticks its `tasks.md` box only when the user says yes.
- A task that was reopened in Azure Boards while its box is ticked unticks the box only when the user says yes.
- Active or another in-progress state is not shown as a difference. People set it, and the kit leaves it alone.
- A new child item is added as a task only on yes. It gets the next `T<n>` in `tasks.md` and a line `Work item: <id> — task: T<n> <short title>` in `work-item.md`. Ids never go into `tasks.md`.

### Reply comments

It strips file paths, line numbers, spec references, and kit names, keeps code repo names, and never mentions the specs repo. The command never writes a field back to Azure Boards.

## What gets written

Only the kept changes: the spec, `tasks.md`, and `work-item.md` lines for added tasks.

## After

```text
$crav1-finalize-commit
```

Reference page: [ado-sync](reference/skills/crav1-ado-sync.md)

The run ends as [How a run ends](reference/run-ending.md) says: Run next, never a `Next:` line, `Waiting:` only when a step is blocked, and `Uncommitted:` when files changed and are not committed.

human: https://github.com/Crav1on/crav1-spec-kit/blob/v1.211.0/docs/from-ado-sync-pull-tasks.md
